name: Heated beard straightener

lead: A heated beard straightener is a comb or flat-iron tool that warms facial hair as it is pulled through, flattening wiry or curly beard hair for a smoother, shaped result. It is used for longer beards.

It gives a quick change in texture but is heat styling, with the risk profile of any hot tool. No research on beard-specific straighteners was found, and the closest evidence concerns heat damage to hair in general.

paras: Heat softens the hydrogen bonds in keratin, letting the hair take a new shape that holds as it cools, until it gets wet or humid.

Hot surfaces can burn skin close to the face, and repeated high heat can crack cuticles and dry the hair, as laboratory studies of hot tools show. Low temperatures, heat protectant and quick passes are reported to lower risk. The straightening effect is temporary.

studies.title: Laboratory study of repeated hair-dryer exposure and cuticle damage (simulated month of daily drying)
